# Capability index -- what an agent can do without asking a person

<!-- GENERATED by bin/idp-capability-index. Do not edit: run the tool. -->

Every tool in `bin/`, described from its own header. An agent reads this before it
decides it needs to ask the founder for something -- the estate has the capability or
the record shows it does not, and either answer is better than an interruption.

**349 tools.** 145 describe themselves; 204 do not.

Find a tool by purpose:  `idp-capability-index --grep <term>`
